question: Whoever desires enjoyments here or there — how is he appointed?
premises: by oneself, by consecration-yoga or by showing of that limb
who desires enjoyments where, he is appointed right there
inference: Self-consecration-yoga appoints the enjoyer where he desires.
uncertainties: tadanga (that limb) referent kept open per gloss
plain_english: By oneself, by consecration-yoga or, that limb is thereby shown — who where desires enjoyments, he is appointed right there.
